prompt: Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: hit while turning left in Sugar Land, Texas. Injury: knee injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1207; do not mention it.)
text: I was making a left turn at an intersection in Sugar Land, Texas, when another vehicle came through the intersection from the opposite direction and struck the driver's side of my car. I had already started into the turn and had checked for oncoming traffic before proceeding. The impact pushed my vehicle sideways and my left knee hit the steering column and dashboard. I was able to get out of the car on my own, but my knee was swollen and painful, and I could not put full weight on it. Responding officers were called to the scene and I gave my statement there. I have since been seen by a medical provider for the knee injury and am following their treatment plan. I am providing this account so the claim can be processed as accurately as possible.
